name: Nestle Close III
source:
A pretty girl who is a daughter of your apartment house's owner is asked to take care of the building during the owner's two weeks absence. How do you get along with her?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024315.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一名漂亮女孩是你所在公寓房东的女儿。
房东离开两周时，她受托照看这栋楼。
你会与她相处得如何？

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024315.html]DLsite English[/url]]
